newsitem.title: CHINA: AWT World shares resume trading.
newsitem.headline: AWT World shares resume trading.

text.p: AWT World Transport Holdings Ltd said it had made an application to resume trading of its share on Friday after being suspended since July 9 due to unusual increases in price and trading volume of its shares.
The company said it had not been approached by any parties in connection with any proposed injection of assets or any possible offer to acquire the company's shares.
It said it was not aware of any material adverse change in the financial position of the company.

However, the company said it "may consider to review alternative means of obtaining long-term capital, including but not limited to placement of new shares, in the light of prevailing market conditions and opportunities which may arise from time to time."
The international air and sea freight forwarding services said the proforma adjusted net tangible asset value per share was HK$0.63 per share as in February.
Its shares were last traded at HK$1.37 on July 8 prior to the suspension.
In April, AWT World had agreed to buy certain shops in Kowloon for HK$50 million, of which HK$20 million would be paid by issue of 24.39 million shares and HK$30 million in cash.
